Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
6:18 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for these basics:

Memory: 16 GB at the least, and upgradable if possible.
Storage: 512 GB fast SSD.
Processor: a recent Ryzen 5 or 7, or a Core i5 or Ultra 5 and above.
Screen and keyboard: a bright full HD screen and a keyboard you like typing on matter more than a graphics card.
Battery: 8 hours or more of real use.

A dedicated graphics card is only worth the extra money for machine learning or game development. For web and app work, skip it and spend on a better screen and build.

What will you mostly build: web and apps, or machine learning? I can then look up current options in your budget.
